scope: Planning and basic scaffold only; all functionality is future work.

epics.name: Desktop foundation and Navis UI
epics.objective: Build the responsive desktop shell, reusable UI, and persisted configuration.

phases.title: Foundation-P1: Desktop shell and design system
criteria: Implement sidebar, toolbar, panel/button tokens and app version in the title based on the product plan.
Keyboard focus, contrast and reduced motion work; browser and Windows Tauri navigation agree.
Loading/empty/error states are demonstrable with fixtures.

phases.title: Foundation-P2: Settings and typed native boundary
criteria: Save schema-versioned root (default C:\Projects), exclusions and preferences atomically in app-specific storage.
Validate paths and typed IPC inputs; malformed config recovers without losing valid settings.
Add only scoped capabilities; no frontend secrets or unrestricted shell.

phases.title: Foundation-P3: Responsive dashboard interactions
criteria: Implement searchable/filterable project list and details panel with stable selection.
Virtualize large lists, avoid main-thread scanning, preserve selection on refresh.
Verify narrow window, keyboard navigation, reduced motion and partial errors.

epics.name: Local project and Git inventory
epics.objective: Discover coding projects and repositories under a configurable root without changing them.

phases.title: Discovery-P1: Bounded project scanner
criteria: Scan canonical configured roots with cancellation/progress, depth and exclusion limits.
Detect non-Git coding projects, nested repos, .git files/worktrees; prevent junction cycles.
Test missing/inaccessible roots, paths with spaces, duplicate worktrees and partial results.

phases.title: Discovery-P2: Git facts and stack detection
criteria: Read branch, dirty state, latest commit, remotes and upstream divergence without Git mutations.
Detect Tauri/mobile/other stack manifests and available workflow prerequisites.
Handle detached HEAD, unborn repos, unsafe ownership, missing git and no upstream with explicit states.

phases.title: Discovery-P3: Incremental refresh and discovery performance
criteria: Debounce watchers, cache facts and support manual refresh/cancellation.
Reconcile added/removed/renamed projects and worktrees without duplicate identities.
Benchmark 100-project fixture against documented targets and retain partial failures.

epics.name: Optional GitHub project context
epics.objective: Enrich local projects with repository activity and issue selection while preserving offline use.

phases.title: GitHub-P1: Auth and remote association
criteria: Associate verified GitHub remotes (HTTPS/SSH) with the correct owner/repo and optional selected account.
Use provider-managed auth or credential references; no tokens in frontend/logs/repo.
Disconnected, non-GitHub and unauthorized repos remain usable locally.

phases.title: GitHub-P2: Cached repository activity
criteria: Show open issue/PR counts, commit summary and direct links with separate remote freshness.
Handle pagination, rate limits, auth expiry, unavailable fields and explicit refresh.
Network failure cannot block local project list or expose unauthorized data.

phases.title: GitHub-P3: Issue picker and workflow context
criteria: Pick a repository issue or enter a URL/number; validate repository scope and closed/blocked states.
Display acceptance criteria and blockers, link parent epic and PR context.
Pass bounded issue context to Work action without altering the issue at selection time.

epics.name: Coding actions and recoverable runs
epics.objective: Provide dev-work/dev-push/dev-build style actions with reliable execution and visible progress.

phases.title: Workflows-P1: Project-aware action registry
criteria: Declare action inputs, supported stacks, skill reference or versioned script, checks and output artifacts.
Discover compatible skills explicitly; show disabled reasons rather than executing Markdown.
Define effect scope so requested commit/push/PR work is explicit; default builds to release.

phases.title: Workflows-P2: Managed execution and streamed runs
criteria: Run configured executables with validated cwd/argument arrays; test Windows cmd/ps1 quoting and paths with spaces.
Stream sequence-numbered output with bounded buffers, input-needed state, timeout and process-tree cancellation.
Persist states and prevent concurrent mutating runs on one repository/worktree.

phases.title: Workflows-P3: Agent-backed work and push actions
criteria: Execute dev-work/dev-push with selected compatible runtime, issue and intentional change scope.
Preflight dirty repos/auth/dependencies and isolate work where needed without automatic broad staging/stashing.
Verify commits, remote push and PR URLs; record side effects to prevent duplicate retry.

phases.title: Workflows-P4: Build artifacts and interrupted-run recovery
criteria: Invoke stack-specific build profiles and verify release artifact path/version; label debug explicitly.
Persist checkpoints, reconcile orphaned processes after restart and offer safe retry.
Verify failures/cancellation leave unrelated files intact and never repeat a completed remote side effect.

epics.name: Configurable coding agents and local models
epics.objective: Support manual provider/model choice with explicit tested capabilities and safe handoff.

phases.title: Providers-P1: Provider contract and configuration
criteria: Define capability-based adapter interface for discovery, health, models, start/cancel/events and checkpoints.
Keep provider, model, reasoning effort and runtime separate; store secret references only.
Show missing executable/auth/unsupported settings; never install or download models implicitly.

phases.title: Providers-P2: Codex coding adapter
criteria: Validate installed CLI/SDK surface and version; normalize streamed events, final output, auth failures and cancellation.
Honor project scope, skill discovery, supported reasoning/model settings and approval/input states.
Complete opt-in temp-repo smoke run; fixture-test malformed streams and provider failures without remote mutation.

phases.title: Providers-P3: Antigravity coding adapter
criteria: Probe installed executable/SDK and documented noninteractive entry point; choose tested integration surface.
Map available settings, skill support, streamed progress and input/cancel semantics into adapter contract.
Document unsupported/missing capabilities honestly and verify Windows temp-repo run or explicit unavailable state.

phases.title: Providers-P4: Ollama coding harness and portable handoff
criteria: Discover configured local models and endpoint health; evaluate explicit compatible agent harness for tools/edit/test execution.
Enforce local-only profile, context/tool capability eligibility and hardware-aware timeout behavior.
Manual switching checkpoints goal/scope/diff/checks/pending work; no silent mid-run switch or duplicated side effects.

epics.name: Usage-aware model routing and pace
epics.objective: Select eligible models transparently using complexity, pace and trustworthy measured usage.

phases.title: Routing-P1: Usage and latency signals
criteria: Represent subscription windows, API spend, context limits and local resource metrics separately with units/source/timestamps.
Collect supported signals; unknown/stale values remain unknown and manual estimates are labelled.
Normalize reset times, test stale/unavailable/rate-limit signals and record per-task latency without secrets.

phases.title: Routing-P2: Explainable complexity and pace policy
criteria: Implement deterministic requirements/complexity rules and Fast/Balanced/Thorough/Economy preferences.
Filter required tools/context/privacy first, then fresh quota/latency/quality preferences; support manual override.
Show selected model and rejected alternatives; desired completion time is a preference with no false guarantee.

phases.title: Routing-P3: Checkpoint fallback and routing calibration
criteria: Switch only at safe checkpoint on configured failure/quota boundary; preserve privacy and user override.
Record decision/policy version and handoff, prevent routing loops and duplicate external mutations.
Evaluate representative task outcomes/latency/usage to tune rules; test unknown usage and exhausted eligible providers.

epics.name: Windows reliability and release delivery
epics.objective: Ship a smooth, recoverable Windows application with verified artifacts and bounded data handling.

phases.title: Release-P1: Cross-feature regression and security checks
criteria: Test scanner/Git/IPC/process/adapter/routing failures using disposable repos and recorded fixtures.
Verify no command injection, root escape, leaked credentials or duplicate mutation; audit capability scopes and CSP.
Document live integration checks separately from fixture coverage; offline and missing-provider paths work.

phases.title: Release-P2: Performance accessibility and diagnostics
criteria: Measure startup, scan/list responsiveness and output floods against documented machine/fixture baselines.
Verify keyboard/contrast/reduced-motion and large-list responsiveness; capture regressions.
Add redacted diagnostics/export and bounded log retention with clear deletion controls.

phases.title: Release-P3: Windows installer and verified release process
criteria: Add app icons, NSIS packaging, synchronized versions and repeatable locked release commands.
Verify executable/installer metadata, clean-machine WebView2 setup, launch and upgrade data preservation.
Publish release checklist and recovery instructions; signing/update strategy documented, distribution separately authorized.
